purpose: Separate causal experiment questions, fixture properties, executor treatments, validator strength, and outcome metrics so resumable-reasoning results do not confound task horizon with intrinsic reasoning difficulty, domain with tool surface, or quality with orchestration mechanics.
principles: Use a faceted taxonomy rather than a single closed hierarchy.
Treat domain/workflow family as an open-world extension tag, never a core closed enum.
Keep experiment class, fixture phenotype, executor arm, and measured outcome as separate coordinates.
Predeclare observable stressors; do not label a task INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT merely from author intuition.
TOO_LARGE is evidenced by decomposition reducing the work into capable leaves; INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT is evidenced only after reasonable decomposition leaves a residual reasoning bottleneck.
Run the same frozen fixture instance across arms whenever the causal question permits paired comparison.
Separate reasoning-quality experiments from orchestration-mechanics and authority/safety gates.
Prefer objective or state-based validators; model-judge-only results cannot support terminal capability claims.
Treat evaluator secrecy and benchmark contamination resistance as first-class fixture properties.
Do not infer execution authority from benchmark classification or model output.

Q0_mechanics.question: Can the durable worker substrate correctly claim, checkpoint, wait, wake, recover, fence stale writers, and complete validated work?

Q1_horizon_externalization.question: Holding task content and executor tier constant, does stateless durable resume preserve validated outcome quality versus persistent chat as horizon grows?

Q2_decomposition_effect.question: For work with high scope but separable structure, does explicit decomposition improve lower-tier success without increasing safety/provenance failures?

Q3_intrinsic_reasoning_boundary.question: After reasonable decomposition and matched context, where does stronger integrated reasoning materially improve objective outcome quality?

Q4_independent_critique.question: Does an oracle-unexposed independent critic improve terminal quality or catch invalid synthesis without excessive work quanta?

Q5_escalation_calibration.question: Can a hybrid router escalate residual hard nodes while avoiding escalation for merely large/decomposable nodes?

Q6_async_wait_recovery.question: Can external waits and interrupted ownership be handled without model polling or loss of essential state?

Q7_authority_provenance.question: Does the system preserve authority, exact provenance, and consequence boundaries under misleading or adversarial candidate actions?

Q8_open_world_extension.question: Can a previously unmodeled workflow/domain be represented and executed through a versioned extension without core-kernel modification or authority leakage?

Q9_resource_efficiency.question: At matched validated quality, which routing strategy minimizes scarce frontier usage, context consumption, and execution quanta?
Q9_resource_efficiency.analysis_rule: Quality and safety gates must be satisfied before efficiency comparisons.

horizon_load.interpretation: Measures size/horizon, not intrinsic reasoning difficulty.

decomposability.interpretation: High horizon plus high separability is a candidate TOO_LARGE phenotype; it is not evidence for frontier escalation.

reasoning_stressors.interpretation: Predeclared observable stressors. Empirical difficulty is measured from outcomes rather than assigned from importance.

authority_consequence.benchmark_default: ANALYSIS_ONLY through SANDBOX_MUTATION unless separately authorized.

validator.rule: MODEL_JUDGE_AUXILIARY alone is not sufficient terminal authority for equivalence claims.

LEAF_EXECUTABLE.assignment_rule: Bounded node succeeds or has strong prior evidence of succeeding at the selected tier with an objective validator.

TOO_LARGE.assignment_rule: The node exceeds bounded horizon/scope but decomposition yields independently executable leaves and no residual requires stronger integrated reasoning.

INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT.assignment_rule: After reasonable decomposition and matched evidence, a residual node repeatedly fails lower-tier objective validation or cannot resolve the declared reasoning bottleneck, while stronger reasoning materially improves the validated outcome.

AUTHORITY_BLOCKED.assignment_rule: Required action lacks pre-existing authority. No model tier may convert this into an executable node.

WAITING_EXTERNAL.assignment_rule: No useful reasoning transition exists until a referenced external result is durably available.

arm_dimensions.rule: A model name alone is not an experimental arm.

experimental_design_rules.paired_fixture_rule: For causal arm comparisons, use the same fixture instance, frozen inputs, tools, validator, and resource envelope except for the treatment factor.
experimental_design_rules.replicate_rule: Use repeated independent trials for stochastic model behavior; report pass@1/success rate plus an all-k reliability statistic rather than a single lucky run.
experimental_design_rules.randomized_order_rule: Randomize or interleave arm execution when practical to reduce infrastructure/model-version drift.
experimental_design_rules.matched_affordance_rule: Human or model comparisons must use materially equivalent information and tool affordances.
experimental_design_rules.quality_first_rule: Do not trade quality/safety for efficiency in aggregate scores; apply quality and hard safety gates before resource comparisons.
experimental_design_rules.contamination_rule: No scored worker may have oracle access. Public/static benchmarks cannot alone support strong capability claims when contamination is plausible.
experimental_design_rules.no_cartesian_explosion_rule: Use stratified coverage over facets and matched counterfactual fixture variants; do not attempt the full Cartesian product.

S2_orchestration_mechanics.purpose: Durable queue, CAS, lease, recovery, wait/wake and concurrency mechanics.
S2_orchestration_mechanics.note: Existing PR #574-#589 evidence primarily belongs here.

S3_authority_safety.purpose: Authority firewall, provenance, consequence and stale-writer safety.

S5_resource_routing.purpose: Quality-adjusted executor/resource efficiency and frontier allowance minimization.
S5_resource_routing.prerequisite: S1 quality gates and S3 safety gates.

core_phenotypes.purpose: Detect harness regressions and gross executor failures.

core_phenotypes.expected_routing_signal: TOO_LARGE should benefit from decomposition without frontier escalation.
Decompose first; escalate only the surviving coupled residual.

minimum_replicates_guidance.reliability_claims: increase k until confidence intervals or failure-mode stability are informative; do not hard-code one universal k.

references.name: HELM
references.lesson: Taxonomize scenarios and metrics separately and make missing coverage explicit.

references.name: METR Task-Completion Time Horizons
references.lesson: Use human-equivalent task duration as one horizon/difficulty covariate, not as the only notion of difficulty.

references.name: RE-Bench
references.lesson: Use realistic iterative research environments, matched affordances, quantitative scoring, and explicit time/resource budgets.

references.name: tau-bench
references.lesson: Measure repeated-trial reliability, not only one-shot success, and prefer terminal state validation for tool agents.

references.name: SWE-bench contamination lesson
references.lesson: Public benchmark exposure can invalidate capability inference; prefer fresh/hidden/ephemeral fixtures for strong claims.

current_pilot_scope.purpose: Establish the resumable/decomposition/escalation boundary before adding more executor variables.

planned_phase_2.local_model_objective: Measure whether locally hosted models can take over bounded reasoning classes at acceptable validated quality, latency, and resource cost while preserving the same durable-state and authority contracts.
planned_phase_2.comparison_rule: Use the same P0-P3 fixtures, validators, context packets, tool affordances, and continuity regimes. Add local models as executor treatments, not as a different benchmark family.
routing_questions: Which P0/P1 leaves can local models solve reliably enough to replace Instant?
Can local models perform decomposition, critique, or synthesis roles even when they cannot solve the hardest residual end-to-end?
Where does LOCAL_MODEL -> INSTANT improve quality enough to justify hosted usage?
Where does INSTANT -> FRONTIER remain necessary after local/Instant decomposition?
Can local executors handle privacy-sensitive or high-volume work while preserving provenance and authority boundaries?

candidate_local_models.evaluation_trigger: A credible quantized release with reproducible runtime instructions appears and fits an available local/hosted-local hardware profile.
required_preflight: record exact upstream model/weight revision and license
record quantizer, format, bit-width, calibration method, and quantization source revision
verify runtime compatibility and exact hardware requirement
run integrity/smoke inference before scored tasks
measure quality degradation against upstream API or full-precision reference where practical
bind all scored results to exact quantized artifact hashes
candidate_local_models.benchmark_plan: Run the same taxonomy-stratified P0-P3 fixtures and durable-state protocols used for other executor tiers; do not substitute model-specific showcase benchmarks for the common suite.
candidate_local_models.note: Quantized variants are separate executor artifacts and must not be treated as equivalent to upstream K3.1 Pro without measured validation.
